# Primary-tumor-only Results

Selection rule: Keep sample_type 01 only; sort 15-character sample_key lexicographically and keep the first key per 12-character participant. Vials/aliquots were already collapsed at the 15-character key by prepare_dataset.py using their mean.

Primary participants: 762; events: 99; censored: 663; removed from 842-record mixed analysis: 80; difference relative to the 762 primary records: 0.

## Main finding

In the primary-only cohort, Clinical-only exceeded Full for CoxPH, RSF, and DeepSurv in the pre-specified paired participant bootstrap whenever each reported Δ was negative. Statistical direction and uncertainty are shown above without selective omission.
